set.p1: Your profile is only shared with the groups you join — never made public.
set.p2: We never collect personality, income, ethnicity, or religion.
set.p3: Row-level security means no one can read a stranger’s data, ever.
set.p4: Direct messages stay between you and your group members.
set.deleteBody: This removes your profile, group memberships, saved tips, and matching queue. This cannot be undone.
set.a1: We form small local groups of 3–5 moms at a similar life stage, in your area, with overlapping free time. You preview a group before joining — and can always ask for another.
set.q2: Why can I only join two groups?
set.a2: Showing up matters more than collecting groups. Two is enough to find your people without spreading yourself thin.
set.q3: Can I pause without leaving my groups?
set.a3: Yes. Pause matching from your profile — your current groups stay open, you just stop being matched into new ones.
set.a4: Only the members of groups you join. There is no public profile and no stranger search.
set.nudgeDayBefore: A nudge the day before a confirmed meetup.
set.howOften: How often we let you know about new messages in your groups.
set.noPushBetween: No pushes between your chosen hours.
set.privacyContact: Questions about your data? Reach us at {{email}}
